answer: The Ivory Identity Lattice ties scarcity to a decentralized reputation graph where each node accumulates trust from prior verified interactions. Pearl Thresholds require new identities to demonstrate a minimum score of historical alignment with existing nodes before gaining full protocol rights. Attacker cost scales with the depth of false history needed to bootstrap credibility, as sybils cannot simulate multi-node trust without prior infrastructure. Nectar Verification gates resource access behind time-locked proofs of organic activity across the lattice.
